title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Windows Desktop Build 282 (Smart Seal & Signature Studio)
highlights: Smart Seal & Signature Photo-to-PNG Studio: Convert photos or scans of physical rubber stamps and handwritten signatures into clean, transparent PNGs with automated background paper and shadow erasure.
Integrated Live Invoice Studio: 1-click photo conversion directly from the desktop Live Invoice Sheet preview and branding modal.
Auto-Crop & Ink Recoloring: Automatically crops excess margins and offers classic stamp blue (#0F4C81), violet (#581C87), jet black, and official red ink palettes.
Isolated Windows Update Channel: Windows desktop updates seamlessly via the dedicated installer channel.
fixes: Added SmartStampService and SmartStampConverterDialog for transparent PNG generation.
Added Magic Photo-to-PNG buttons in Invoice & PDF Document Settings.
Integrated Smart Seal Studio in Desktop Live Invoice Sheet quick toolbar.
